title: Quadrilaterals: Properties of Quadrilaterals

standard_text: Angle sum of a quadrilateral; properties of parallelograms, rectangles, rhombuses, squares, kites and trapeziums; relationships between quadrilaterals (summary of NCERT Ganita Prakash Class 8)

key_big: The angles of a quadrilateral add up to 360°
key_sub: In a parallelogram, opposite angles are equal and adjacent angles add up to 180°.
body_html:
How it works

A quadrilateral splits into two triangles, so its angles add up to 360°.

Parallelogram: opposite sides parallel and equal, opposite angles equal, diagonals bisect each other. A rectangle also has equal diagonals; a rhombus has perpendicular diagonals; a square has both.

A kite has two pairs of equal adjacent sides; a trapezium has one pair of parallel sides.

Example

Three angles of a quadrilateral are 80°, 95° and 110°. Find the fourth.

360° − (80° + 95° + 110°)

Answer: 75°

Example

In parallelogram ABCD, ∠A = 65°. Find ∠B.

Adjacent angles add up to 180°

Answer: 115°

Common mistakes

  • Using 180° as the angle sum of a quadrilateral.
  • Taking adjacent angles of a parallelogram as equal.
  • Thinking a rhombus always has equal diagonals. Only a square does.

faq.q: What is the angle sum of a quadrilateral?
faq.a: 360°, because a diagonal splits it into two triangles.

faq.q: What are the properties of a parallelogram?
faq.a: Opposite sides are parallel and equal, opposite angles are equal, adjacent angles add up to 180° and the diagonals bisect each other.
Yes. A square has four equal sides, so it is a rhombus; it is also a rectangle.

items.q: In which quadrilateral do the diagonals bisect each other at right angles, but are not always equal?

items.q: In parallelogram ABCD, angle A = 79°. What is angle B?
items.e: Angles A and B are co-interior, so they add to 180°: 180° − 79° = 101°.

items.q: In parallelogram ABCD, angle A = 94°. What is angle C?
items.e: Opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal: 94°.

items.q: ABCD is a parallelogram. BE = 2x + 10 and ED = 4x + 2. Find x.
items.e: The diagonals bisect each other, so BE = ED: 2x + 10 = 4x + 2, so 2x = 8 and x = 4.

items.q: ABCD is a parallelogram. AE = 4x + 11 and EC = 6x + 7. Find AC.
items.e: The diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other, so AE = EC: 4x + 11 = 6x + 7, so 2x = 4 and x = 2. AC = 2 × 19 = 38.

items.q: ABCD is a parallelogram. Find x.

items.q: ABCD is a parallelogram. AB = 4x + 5 and CD = 3x + 8. Find AB.
items.e: Opposite sides of a parallelogram are congruent: 4x + 5 = 3x + 8, so x = 3. AB = 17.

items.q: An isosceles trapezium has two angles of 85° at its longer parallel side. What is each of the other two angles?
items.e: Each pair of co-interior angles adds to 180°: 180° − 85° = 95°.

items.q: ABCD is a parallelogram. BE = 5x − 3 and ED = 6x − 6. Find x.
items.e: The diagonals bisect each other, so BE = ED: 5x − 3 = 6x − 6, so x = 3.

items.q: In trapezium ABCD, AB is parallel to DC and angle A = 56°. What is angle D?
items.e: Angles A and D are co-interior between parallel lines, so they add to 180°: 124°.

items.q: ABCD is a parallelogram. BE = 6x + 9 and ED = 4x + 21. Find x.
items.e: The diagonals bisect each other, so BE = ED: 6x + 9 = 4x + 21, so 2x = 12 and x = 6.

items.q: ABCD is a parallelogram. AB = 2x + 5 and CD = 3x − 2. Find AB.
items.e: Opposite sides of a parallelogram are congruent: 2x + 5 = 3x − 2, so x = 7. AB = 19.

items.q: ABCD is a parallelogram. Find x.

items.q: The diagonals of rectangle ABCD meet at E. AC = 22 cm. How long is BE?
items.e: The diagonals of a rectangle are equal and bisect each other, so BE = ½ × 22 = 11 cm.

items.q: A rhombus has one side of length 20. What is its perimeter?
items.e: All four sides of a rhombus are congruent: 4 × 20 = 80.

items.q: ABCD is a rectangle with diagonals meeting at E. AE = x + 4 and BD = 3x − 1. Find x.
items.e: The diagonals of a rectangle are congruent and bisect each other, so BD = AC = 2 × AE: 3x − 1 = 2(x + 4), x = 9.

items.q: The diagonals of a square meet at E. AE = 8. Find BD, and the measure of ∠AEB.
items.e: A square is a rectangle (congruent diagonals that bisect each other) and a rhombus (perpendicular diagonals). BD = 16 and ∠AEB = 90°.

items.q: A rhombus has one side of length 19. What is its perimeter?
items.e: All four sides of a rhombus are congruent: 4 × 19 = 76.

items.q: ABCD is a rhombus with diagonals meeting at E, and ∠ABE = 52°. Find ∠BAE.
items.e: The diagonals of a rhombus are perpendicular, so ∠AEB = 90°. ∠BAE = 180 − 90 − 52 = 38°.

items.q: ABCD is a rectangle with diagonals meeting at E. AE = 5x + 12 and BD = 4x + 36. Find x.
items.e: The diagonals of a rectangle are congruent and bisect each other, so BD = AC = 2 × AE: 4x + 36 = 2(5x + 12), x = 2.

items.q: In rectangle ABCD, AC = 2x + 1 and BD = 13 cm. Find x.
items.e: The diagonals of a rectangle are equal: 2x + 1 = 13, so 2x = 12 and x = 6.

items.q: A rhombus has one side of length 8. What is its perimeter?
items.e: All four sides of a rhombus are congruent: 4 × 8 = 32.

items.q: ABCD is a rhombus, and ∠BAC = 47°. Find ∠BAD.
items.e: The diagonals of a rhombus bisect its angles, so ∠BAD = 2 × 47° = 94°.

items.q: The diagonals of a rhombus are 18 cm and 24 cm long. How long is each side?
items.e: The diagonals bisect each other at right angles, making right-angled triangles with legs 9 cm and 12 cm. Side = √(9² + 12²) = 15 cm.

items.q: The diagonals of a rhombus are 10 cm and 24 cm long. How long is each side?
items.e: The diagonals bisect each other at right angles, making right-angled triangles with legs 5 cm and 12 cm. Side = √(5² + 12²) = 13 cm.

items.q: The diagonals of parallelogram PQRS meet at M. PM = 3x + 6 and MR = x + 12. Find x.
items.e: The diagonals bisect each other, so PM = MR: 3x + 6 = x + 12. So 2x = 6 and x = 3.

items.q: The diagonals of rectangle ABCD meet at E. AC = 12 cm. How long is BE?
items.e: The diagonals of a rectangle are equal and bisect each other, so BE = ½ × 12 = 6 cm.

items.q: ABCD is a rhombus, and ∠BAC = 54°. Find ∠BAD.
items.e: The diagonals of a rhombus bisect its angles, so ∠BAD = 2 × 54° = 108°.

items.q: The diagonals of a square meet at E. AE = 4. Find BD, and the measure of ∠AEB.
items.e: A square is a rectangle (congruent diagonals that bisect each other) and a rhombus (perpendicular diagonals). BD = 8 and ∠AEB = 90°.

items.q: ABCD is a rhombus, and ∠BAC = 42°. Find ∠BAD.
items.e: The diagonals of a rhombus bisect its angles, so ∠BAD = 2 × 42° = 84°.

items.q: A rhombus has one side of length 12. What is its perimeter?

items.q: ABCD is a rectangle with diagonals meeting at E. AE = x + 10 and BD = 6x + 4. Find x.
items.e: The diagonals of a rectangle are congruent and bisect each other, so BD = AC = 2 × AE: 6x + 4 = 2(x + 10), x = 4.

items.q: ABCD is a rhombus, and ∠BAC = 62°. Find ∠BAD.

items.q: The diagonals of a rhombus are 12 cm and 16 cm long. How long is each side?

items.q: ABCD is a parallelogram. AB = 4x + 14 and CD = 6x + 10. Find AB.

items.q: ABCD is a parallelogram. Find x.

items.q: ABCD is a parallelogram. AB = 4x + 4 and CD = 5x + 2. Find AB.

items.q: An isosceles trapezium has two angles of 81° at its longer parallel side. What is each of the other two angles?

items.q: ABCD is a parallelogram. AE = x + 3 and EC = 4x − 27. Find AC.
items.e: The diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other, so AE = EC: x + 3 = 4x − 27, so 3x = 30 and x = 10. AC = 2 × 13 = 26.

items.q: The diagonals of parallelogram PQRS meet at M. PM = 4x + 6 and MR = 3x + 8. Find x.
items.e: The diagonals bisect each other, so PM = MR: 4x + 6 = 3x + 8. So x = 2 and x = 2.
